title: Tekkno Rave DAW: Beat Maker
short_description: Hard techno and hardcore groovebox with pads, a pitch grid and a song view.

guides.title: BPM to ms Chart for Hard Techno, 140 to 220 BPM
guides.description: Milliseconds per beat, 16th note and bar for 140 to 220 BPM, with the formulas and a worked example for song length in seconds.

guides.title: Scale Intervals Chart for Minor, Phrygian, Harmonic Minor
guides.description: Semitone intervals for minor, major, phrygian, harmonic minor and minor pentatonic scales, plus the pitch ratio of every semitone.
